analysis:
Integration of all 29 units. The PR is mostly documentation plus a local deadline-admission change. Reviewed: changelog.d/deadline-admission-estimators.md; docs in hardware-support.md, inference.md, test.md, cli-reference.md, configuration.md, prediction-decision-telemetry.md, protocol-messages.md and serving-performance-qualification.md. Source reviewed: EnginePerformanceMeasurements, EngineV2Bridge (+Accounting/+Admission/+Measurements/+RateObservations), new AdmissionRateEstimators.swift, WholeMacServiceBudget.isIdle(except:), LaunchAgent.swift passthrough, and three test files.

Security-relevant behavior: (1) The estimators change only the local first-token deadline time check. The docs state that KV grants, load quotation, activation floors, serving width and slot/byte admission are unchanged. The change relates to availability (T-010, T-029); it avoids lockout from one slow isolated sample by flooring the prefill rate at 1/8 of the startup calibration and by treating stale evidence on an idle Mac as absent after 30 minutes. The residual risk is more permissive admission on a degraded Mac; bounded by the idle and nominal-posture gating, the actual elapsed deadline expiry, and physical admission. (2) DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES=0 is an operator-local rollback. It is forwarded by LaunchAgent via a static allowlist, is non-empty only, and follows the pattern of the sibling keys. The operator is already trusted over local config (TB-003), so there is no new remote surface; the worker opt-in forwarding of only '1' is unchanged. (3) Freshness is now anchored to the newest observation (max(at, now) in Rate.observe). This lengthens evidence lifetime only for late-arriving completed work, and sample_age_ms uses a non-negative clamp. Wire fields are unchanged. The telemetry is provider-reported and untrusted, so there is no authorization-bearing change. (4) The documented default flip of DARKBLOOM_PREFILL_DEADLINE_MODE to enforce is an availability and admission change that fails closed. The code was not supplied. (5) No change touches the coordinator-provider crypto, key custody, App Attest (TB-011/T-053), or the prefix-cache tier (T-041: TTL, HMAC tags, scope, kill switch). No data from consumer prompts enters the new estimators beyond numeric shapes and timings.

Coverage limits for later passes: the full AdmissionRateEstimators.swift (MeasuredDecodeStep, IsolatedPrefillAdmissionRate, DeadlineAdmissionFixes parsing) was shown only as a truncated patch or not at all, as was the head text of Admission.swift. Division, NaN and overflow handling, the callers of isIdle(except:), and the doc claim that the DeadlineRuntimeEnvironment.permitsQualification allowlist treats the new env var correctly are unverified. I found no concrete regression.
